function: Federated D3QN assigns one resource block per ground D2D link to avoid conflicts (hypergraph node coloring), a radio resource scheduling decision above the physical layer (pp. 1, 3, 8).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 8: "performs the corresponding RB selection operation Ar and node selection", i.e. one resource block per D2D link, posed as hypergraph node coloring (p. 1); links are among ground devices (p. 3: "N IoTDs are randomly distributed on the ground") and the UAVs are fixed (p. 3: "stationed at predetermined locations"), so the aerial-link exception does not apply. FedAvg is digital, not area 7. Even if RB allocation counted as physical layer, it solves none of the seven areas.
